name: Chlothar I
role: King of the Franks of the Merovingian dynasty
contribution: A king of the Franks of the Merovingian dynasty and one of the four sons of Clovis I.

checks.lead: Chlothar I, sometime called "the Old" (French: le Vieux), (died c. December 561) also anglicised as Clotaire from the original French version, was a king of the Franks of the Merovingian dynasty and one of the four sons of Clovis I.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
